decisions.rationale: The pattern is market-specific: Nigeria 333/333 and UEMOA 112/118 lack ISIN while Morocco/CEMAC are complete. Treat ISIN as source availability/identifier coverage, not a mandatory fabricated field.

71 funds lack societe_id. Only 28 of the 70 funds with manager text have an exact current societes.nom match (24 Nigeria + 4 Tunisia); Morocco has 23 with zero exact matches. Auto-fill by string equality alone would leave significant unresolved cases.
SICAV ABDOU DIOUF appears twice in UEMOA with two ISIN variants. Same normalized name can represent distinct instruments/classes; identity requires source evidence.
Existing missing relations must be reconciled before any database FK is introduced.

mini_lots: Build a manager-alias candidate report for the 70 text_without_id funds with exact/fuzzy/country-aware evidence, no DB write.
Classify the 23 Morocco manager labels against official manager entities; do not invent matches.
Classify Nigeria/Tunisia exact matches separately from fuzzy/ambiguous matches.
Investigate the UEMOA duplicate-name pair using ISIN/source history; preserve both unless proven duplicate.
Document market-specific identifier policy: ISIN when official/published, otherwise canonical internal ID + source aliases.
promotion_ready_work.write_gate: Any societe_id update or FK addition requires a separately promoted task with snapshot, exact mappings, rollback, post-check and consumer regression tests.

next_action: Create read-only manager alias/match candidates from current fund and societes data, then attach only proven mappings to a future governed correction.
